follow-up time: Median follow-up was 8.3 years for ART-conceived children and 13.7 years for non-ART-conceived children.
cohort: 76,184 liveborn singletons born after ART and 4,403,419 born without ART in Denmark, Finland, and Norway.
finding: Children born after ART did not have a significantly different risk of developing Type 1 diabetes compared to those conceived naturally, except for a potentially higher risk in the youngest cohort (born 2011-2015) which requires further investigation.
